🇰🇷🚨 SOUTH KOREA INVESTIGATES AI-ASSISTED HACKING CAMPAIGN AGAINST 7 FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS  South Korean authorities are investigating what appears to be a coordinated cyber campaign targeting the country's financial sector.  Confirmed affected organizations currently include:  * Shinhan Bank * KB Kookmin Bank * Hana Bank * BNK Busan Bank * Hyundai Capital * Yegaram Savings Bank * Welcome Savings Bank  Authorities say the SAME ATTACKER IP infrastructure was identified across multiple incidents.  The attacker also repeatedly rotated IP addresses while continuing attacks.  More unusually:  Investigators found evidence suggesting AI tooling may have been used to automate attacks against multiple financial institutions at scale.  According to Korean financial-sector investigators, traces associated with:  ARTEX AI  were found in infrastructure used against banks.  ARTEX AI is described as an open-source LLM-based autonomous penetration-testing system.  However:  ⚠️ This DOES NOT establish who conducted the attacks.  The tool is publicly available, attacker infrastructure spans multiple countries, and attribution remains under investigation.  The compromises reportedly targeted comparatively overlooked external systems, including:  * Employee support portals * Loan-agent systems * Internet-facing web services * Systems missing authentication controls * Web applications with access-control weaknesses * Servers affected by known vulnerabilities  Attackers reportedly installed malware in at least some cases and stole log files containing customer information.  Authorities say there is currently NO indication that internet/mobile banking systems were compromised or that direct financial losses occurred.  South Korea has now escalated nationally.  On October 4:  * The Financial Services Commission convened an emergency sector-wide meeting * Attack IPs + defensive guidance were distributed to ~500 financial companies * Banks/card companies were ordered to complete emergency checks by October 6 * Securities, insurance, savings banks and electronic-finance companies must complete checks by October 8 * KISA activated an emergency response posture * President Lee Jae Myung ordered a thorough investigation and countermeasures  ⚠️ Analyst Note:  If investigators confirm substantial autonomous-AI involvement, this incident deserves close attention.  The important evolution isn't simply:  "hackers used AI."  It is the possibility of an attacker using agentic tooling to repeatedly probe MANY organizations, discover weak peripheral systems and scale exploitation across an entire industry.  AI could turn:  ONE ATTACKER ↓ AUTOMATED RECON ↓ AUTOMATED VULNERABILITY DISCOVERY ↓ MASS TARGET SELECTION ↓ PARALLEL INTRUSION ATTEMPTS.  The investigation is ongoing.  Latest Korean investigation details: yna.co.kr/view/AKR2026100402… #SouthKorea #AISecurity #AgenticAI #Banking #CyberAttack #ThreatIntel #DDW

【朝のセキュリティ】脅威動向 (2026-10-05)  今週も焦点はネットワーク境界の機器。FortiMail（メールゲートウェイ）とNetScaler（リモートアクセス装置）の悪用が続いており、外部公開している組織は今日中に版数と侵害痕跡の確認を。国内では能動的サイバー防御法が10/1に施行された。  🚨 脆弱性・パッチ 🔴 Fortinet FortiMail → CVE-2026-104286 / CVSS 9.8。認証なしで任意のファイルを書き込める欠陥で、Fortinetが悪用を確認。CISA KEV（悪用確認済み脆弱性の米政府リスト）に10/1登録。一部の版は修正版が「近日公開」のため、IBE機能の無効化と管理画面のインターネット非公開で回避し、ベンダ公表のIoC（侵害の痕跡）を照合する。 🔴 Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway → CVE-2026-88771（CVSS 9.5）と CVE-2026-88772 が悪用中。GoogleのMandiantは88772経由で数十組織の被害を報告。管理者アカウントの不正追加やWebシェル設置が観測されており、パッチ適用だけでなく不審アカウントと設定ファイルの改ざん有無も確認する。JPCERT/CCも注意喚起を更新済み。 🟡 Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager → CVE-2026-76504 / CVSS 9.8。認証回避で管理者権限のAPIに到達できる。9月に悪用が判明し、CISA KEVに9/30登録。修正版へ更新し、Cisco指定のログで不審なログイン要求を確認する。  🕵️ 攻撃・インシデント ・米国防総省DMDC（人事データ管理部門）→ ファイル共有システムの脆弱性を突かれ、2025年10月から約9か月にわたり不正アクセス。暗号化されていない人事記録が流出し、影響は約300万人（社会保障番号を含む）。 ・中国系とされる攻撃グループUAT-11587 → Cisco Talosの報告。台湾・インド・フィリピン等の政府・政策機関を標的型メールで狙い、新種バックドア「Antino」を約350端末に設置。OutlookとOneDriveを指令通信に悪用するため、正規のクラウド通信に紛れる点が厄介。 ・ローソン → 自社のメールサーバーが第三者に不正利用され、9/25〜27に「Mutual Benefit」等の件名の英文詐欺メール約70万件が送信された。同社は個人情報流出やマルウェア感染は確認されていないとしている。  📜 規制・当局の動き ・日本 能動的サイバー防御 → サイバー対処能力強化法の主要規定が10/1に施行。基幹インフラ事業者のインシデント報告義務、約100組織の官民協議会、警察・自衛隊による攻撃サーバの無害化措置が始動。対象事業者は報告手順と期限を社内規程に反映済みか確認を。  #サイバーセキュリティ #脆弱性 #セキュリティ

「GitLab」の利用者が自社で運用するセルフホスト型のAIゲートウェイで、AIエージェント基盤「GitLab-Duo-Agent-Platform」へのアクセス権を持つ認証済み利用者が、AIゲートウェイ上で任意のコマンドを実行し得る脆弱性「CVE-2026-90970」が修正されています。  AIゲートウェイは、GitLab-DuoのAI機能と大規模言語モデルの間を中継するコンポーネントで、細工したフロー設定を用いるとプロンプトテンプレートのサンドボックスの制限を回避できたとのこと。深刻度はCritical、CVSS3.1の基本値は9.9との同社の評価です。  修正版は19.2.4、19.3.2、19.4.1で、同社はセルフホスト型AIゲートウェイを導入している顧客に即時の更新を強く推奨。公表に先立ち、該当する顧客へ個別に連絡済みとしています。  【要点の整理】  ・問題の箇所は、利用者が作成するフロー（カスタムフロー）のプロンプトテンプレートで、分類は不適切な無害化（Improper Neutralization）  ・CVSSのベクトルはAV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H。ネットワーク経由で低い権限のまま成立し、影響がAIゲートウェイ自体の範囲を超えうる（スコープ変更）との評価  ・影響を受けるAIゲートウェイは、18.1.6以上19.2.4未満、19.3以上19.3.2未満、19.4以上19.4.1未満  ・同社が運用するAIゲートウェイは修正済み。GitLab[.]com、GitLab Dedicated、同社運用のAIゲートウェイを使うSelf-Managedの各顧客は保護されており、対応は不要  ・報告はHackerOne経由の研究者による責任ある開示。記事には悪用の有無への言及はなし  詳細は以下を参照：  docs.gitlab.com/releases/pat…  (※可能な範囲でファクトチェックは実施済なものの、元記事の精度依存や速報・要約の性質上漏れもありうるため、正確な情報は一次情報を直接参照のこと)

【「クラウドネイティブ会議」レポート】 問題のあるOSSコンポーネントの99.5%には修正版がある。でも80%以上のアプリでは依存関係が1年以上更新されていない——Docker, Inc.の根本征氏が解説した「Hardened Container Images」。  ⚠️ 構造的な問題 コンテナイメージはOS・ランタイム・OSパッケージ・依存パッケージなど多数のOSSで構成される 広く使われるパッケージを1つ改ざんするだけで多数のアプリに影響が及ぶ Log4Shellは公開から3年以上経っても影響バージョンが13%程度ダウンロードされていた 🔍 選定の2基準 信頼できるパブリッシャーから選ぶ、必要最小限の構成を選ぶ ただしAlpineは互換性、Distrolessはデバッグの難しさが課題で、組織全体のルールにすると統制が効きにくい 🛡️ Hardened Container Images 不要な依存関係を削減して既知のCVEをほぼゼロに近づけ、修正時間をSLAで保証する製品も デモではFROMのパス置き換えで移行し、イメージサイズは約600MB→約300MBに  脆弱性を後から追いかけるのではなく、初めから減らす——その設計思想が明快だ。  🔗 thinkit.co.jp/article/39592 #コンテナ #Docker #セキュリティ #クラウドネイティブ

FIPS 13.1 boxes need 13.1-37.282.

🚨 #ALERT — WARLOCK RANSOMWARE CAMPAIGN HITS WATER AND TELECOM OPERATORS THROUGH SHAREPOINT  October 1, 2026  DISCLOSED BY:  Symantec / Carbon Black  CONFIRMED EXPLOITED BY:  Symantec / Carbon Black  PRODUCT:  Microsoft SharePoint Server — On-Premises  CVE:  Multiple SharePoint vulnerabilities are used across the campaign.  Historically associated ToolShell flaws include CVE-2025-49704, CVE-2025-49706, CVE-2025-53770 and CVE-2025-53771.  IMPACT:  Symantec documented a recent Warlock campaign compromising at least four organizations, including a water utility and telecommunications provider, plus a regional government body and university.  In one critical-infrastructure intrusion, attackers disabled security tooling on at least 40 hosts in roughly two hours and deployed Warlock ransomware to at least 33 systems through the domain SYSVOL share.  EXPLOITATION STATUS:  CONFIRMED OPERATIONAL RANSOMWARE CAMPAIGN  CISA records knownRansomwareCampaignUse: Known for the core ToolShell KEV entries CVE-2025-49704, CVE-2025-49706 and CVE-2025-53770.  The exact SharePoint CVE used for every recent intrusion has NOT been established.  Attribution:  Symantec tracks the actor as Longlegs, also associated with Storm-2603, and assesses it as China-nexus.  This is NOT a formal government attribution to the Chinese state.  Forensic triage:  Hunt for SharePoint LAYOUTS web shells, stolen ASP.NET machine keys, K7RKScan/BYOVD activity, Visual Studio Code tunnels, NetExec, suspicious SYSVOL payloads and domain-wide ransomware staging.  URGENT ACTION:  Patch all on-premises SharePoint servers.  Previously exposed systems require compromise assessment, ASP.NET machine-key rotation, credential review, and hunting across SYSVOL and domain controllers; patching alone does not establish that the environment is clean.  SOURCE: security.com/threat-intellig…   CISA: cisa.gov/known-exploited-vul…   BACKUP: raw.githubusercontent.com/ci…   CONFIDENCE:  VERY HIGH for the campaign, victim scope and observed post-exploitation behavior based on direct Symantec/Carbon Black investigations. The China-nexus attribution is a vendor intelligence assessment, not a formal government attribution.  #CyberSecurity #ThreatIntel #NØØT #Microsoft #SharePoint #ToolShell #Warlock #Storm2603 #Ransomware #ActiveExploitation #CriticalInfrastructure #IncidentResponse #DigitalForensics

Patched @NetScaler  for CTX697096 and use SAML? Patch again.  CVE-2026-88779 is a separate bulletin, CTX697174 (CVSS 8.7), not part of CTX697096. It's the SAML attack crashing patched NetScalers since 2 Oct. @citrix sees targeted attacks.  Affected: "add authentication samlAction" or "samlIdPProfile" in ns.conf Fixed: 14.1-73.41, 13.1-64.28, 14.1-73.41 FIPS, 13.1-37.282 Interim: Global Deny List (NetScaler Console) or Citrix Support's responder policy, -type AAA_REQUEST on every Gateway/AAA vserver  Free checker v1.12 covers both bulletins: • CVE-2026-88779 on every run • SAML policy coverage per vserver • "may have run" window ends at the fix • 98 IPs, 16 domains, 34 hashes  Thanks to @GothamTG , @BeazleySecurity , @Deyda84  , @citrixguyblog , @rjfaulknerjr @FerroqueSystems, @bishopfox , @watchtowrcyber and the community 🙏  #NetScaler #Citrix #CitrixNetScaler #NetScalerGateway #CVE202688779 #CVE202688771 #CTX697174 #CTX697096 #CyberSecurity #InfoSec #IncidentResponse #ThreatHunting

Specifically, look at NIST SP 800-53 (security controls) and NIST SP 800-37 (Risk Management Framework). • ISO/IEC 27001 & 27002: The international benchmarks for establishing, implementing, and maintaining an Information Security Management System (ISMS). • CIS Critical Security Controls (CIS Top 18): A highly actionable, prioritized set of safeguarding actions to stop today’s most pervasive cyber attacks. 🪟 Cyber Attack Techniques & Vulnerabilities • MITRE ATT&CK Framework: A comprehensive, globally accessible knowledge base of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) based on real-world observations. • OWASP Top 10 / OWASP LLM Top 10: The definitive guides for web application security flaws and vulnerabilities specific to Large Language Models (essential since you are deploying an agent). • CVE and NVD Databases: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) and the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) provide a live dictionary of publicly known cybersecurity vulnerabilities. ⚙️ Technical System Hardening • CIS Benchmarks: Over 100 consensus-based configuration guidelines to securely configure operating systems, cloud environments, and software packages. 🚨 Real-Time Threat Intelligence • CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog: A live directory managed by the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency listing vulnerabilities that are actively being exploited in the wild. • ISAC feeds (Information Sharing and Analysis Centers): Sector-specific threat intelligence (e.g., Financial Services ISAC, Health ISAC) that keeps the agent aware of industry-targeted campaigns. ⚖️ Regulatory & Legal Compliance • Regulatory Mandates (GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS): Depending on your industry, the agent must use these frameworks as a source to ensure your security posture meets legal data protection requirements.

マルウェア解析の学び方を、空の仮想マシンの準備から最初の解析レポートの作成まで6段階で示した学習の手引き。初学者が最初の週にGhidraを開いて挫折しがちなのは難しさではなく順序の問題で、リバースエンジニアリングは前提知識の連鎖の終盤に置くべきだという主張。  環境構築→基礎知識→静的解析→動的解析→リバースエンジニアリング→検知・報告の順に、各段階の所要期間と次へ進む目安となる到達目標を整理し、週8〜10時間で約6か月の学習計画も添えた構成です。検体の安全な入手と扱い方、解析結果を検知・対応の担当者が使える形にまとめる方法まで扱っており、防御側の学習の進め方を確認する材料として有益な内容。  【要点の整理】  ・第1段階は隔離した解析環境の構築。Defenderと自動更新を無効にしたWindows 10のVMにMandiantのFLARE-VMでツール一式を導入し、通信の模擬などには解析向けLinuxのREMnuxを2台目のVMとして併用。ネットワークはホストオンリーか両VM間の内部ネットワークとし、ブリッジ接続や、検体実行中の実インターネット接続は使わない。なお、VirtualBoxなどのホストオンリーは仕様上ホストとも通信できるため、「VMからホストへ到達できない」という記事の確認基準を満たすのは内部ネットワーク側  ・検体の実行中は共有フォルダー、クリップボード共有、ドラッグ＆ドロップを禁止。検体はパスワード付きアーカイブ（研究者間の慣例はinfected）で扱い、解析VM内でのみ入手してホストには保存しない。新しい検体の前には必ずクリーンなスナップショットへ復元。入手先としてMalwareBazaar、theZoo、vx-underground、『Practical Malware Analysis』の演習用検体を紹介  ・第2段階は、プロセスやDLLの読み込み、永続化の定番箇所などのWindowsの内部構造、PE形式、x86／x64のアセンブリと、逆コンパイル結果を読める程度のC言語。第3段階は検体を実行しない静的解析で、ハッシュ、マジックバイトによる実際のファイル形式、文字列、インポート関数、エントロピーから挙動を予測し、次の動的解析で答え合わせする練習。インポートの組み合わせから、ダウンローダー、ランサムウェア、情報窃取型、パック済みを見分ける読み方も例示  ・第4段階は動的解析。ProcmonやProcess Hacker、Regshot、Autorunsでファイル・レジストリ・プロセスの変化と永続化を観察し、INetSimやFakeNetで外部サービスの応答を模擬してWiresharkで通信を記録。ミューテックスは検知用シグネチャとして有用との指摘。動作が見られない場合は、仮想環境やデバッガーの検知、長時間の待機、起動引数や特定のエクスポート関数の呼び出しが必要な可能性も確認し、回避行動そのものも情報として記録  ・第5段階はGhidraやx64dbgによるリバースエンジニアリングで、到達目標は手動でのパック解除と、指令サーバーのアドレスなどの設定の抽出。第6段階はYARA・Sigmaの検知ルールの作成と、正規のソフトウェアで誤検知しないかの確認、MITRE ATT&CKへの対応付け、報告書の作成  ・報告書は、管理者向けの要約、検体の識別情報、機能の概要、侵害指標、検知ルール、推奨対応の6項目で構成する例を提示。最終段階の到達目標は、その検体を見たことのない人が報告書だけで組織全体を調査できる状態  詳細は以下を参照：  hacklido.com/blog/1665-how-t…  (※可能な範囲でファクトチェックは実施済なものの、元記事の精度依存や速報・要約の性質上漏れもありうるため、正確な情報は一次情報を直接参照のこと)

Chapter 4a - Integration “Then I saw and considered it; I looked and received instruction.” (Proverbs 24:32) amazon.com/dp/B07RQH5DPL Shortly after returning home, a voice in a vivid dream told me, “You have been given a great gift.” Unquestionably this experience has been a blessing for my life here – but I look forward to the moment I will return to God. The insights gained from the experience do not overthrow my previous understanding – but deepen and affirm it. I re-examined my life many times, especially turning points as well as my current conduct. I also considered this experience in relation to abundant evidence of NDE’s of others. There are, literally thousands of people who have had positive NDE’s as well as some who describe very negative NDE’s. In and of themselves, they do not constitute a body of teaching, but at minimum they should provoke doubt about a purely materialistic world view. I have read a few studies of Out of Hospital Cardiac Arrest (OHCA) NDE’s and admit that it is amusing that, as far as I know, none of the researchers personally experienced one. Their assessments are wide-ranging. For instance, a Dutch study reported: “Our results show that medical factors cannot account for the occurrence of NDE. All patients had a cardiac arrest, and were clinically dead with unconsciousness resulting from insufficient blood supply to the brain. In those circumstances, the EEG (a measure of brain electrical activity) becomes flat, and if CPR is not started within 5-10 minutes, irreparable damage is done to the brain and the patient will die. According to the theory that NDE is caused by anoxia, all patients in our study should have had an NDE, but only 18% reported having an NDE.”1 A recent study noted the lack of time perception of the Life Review within the NDE.2 “The researchers concluded that unusual memory events did occur among those who had approached death—but not in the way depicted in movies. There was no chronological timeline, for example. Instead, people experienced random memories that they described as occurring without the feeling of time passing. Some described memories as feeling as if they were happening simultaneously, like a video collage of sorts, though they were able to separate the events they experienced. Many of the memories were described as exceptionally vivid and emotional.”3  While researchers offer various theories to other researchers to explain the experiences, a singular conviction of the reality of the experience by those that have had them challenges some explanations. Several patients have experienced hallucinations, delirium, nightmares, “bad trips” and other cognitive experiences, as well as the NDE. Yet by all accounts they have not confused the former with an NDE.  Rather, a consistent theme is that the experience changes them for the better, their outlook on life, its purpose and their relationships to others. It certainly changed my outlook on life, drawing into sharp focus my relationships with others and my relationship with God. The aptness of St. Paul’s admonition to the Colossians is striking: “For you have died, and your life is hid with Christ in God.” (Colossians 3:3)4 The Believer should have a profoundly different perspective on life because the commitment to this new life should have the same effect as those who know for certain what will pass away and what will endure. Do my outward activities change? I still love building things, mowing my lawn, playing computer chess and grilling, but any opportunity to let people know that God loves them takes priority: assisting at mass, offering wake services and funerals, teaching faith-formation classes, working with our Saint Vincent de Paul group and with our Knights of Columbus – as well as just remembering to smile at people I meet as I go about my daily life. Some people close to me are undeterred in their atheistic outlook. For the most part, I have not tried to go beyond simply sharing the bare details of the experience, so I do not have an idea of what their perception is. I am reminded of the parable of the rich man and the poor Lazarus: “…neither will they be convinced if some one should rise from the dead.” (Luke 16:31)

sample_tweets.text: TO JEST TAKŻE NASZA WOJNA. ROSJA NIE MUSI WJECHAĆ CZOŁGIEM DO WARSZAWY, ŻEBY ATAKOWAĆ POLSKĘ. A POWTARZANIE „TO NIE NASZA SPRAWA” NIE ZAPEWNI NAM BEZPIECZEŃSTWA. Szczepan Twardoch otrzymał Nike Czytelników 2026 za „Null”, powieść osadzoną w realiach pierwszej linii frontu w Ukrainie. To dobry moment, żeby wyjść poza gratulacje i powiedzieć coś, czego część ludzi uparcie nie chce usłyszeć: obrona Ukrainy nie jest wyłącznie sprawą Ukraińców. A lektura o ich doświadczeniu nie musi służyć wzruszeniu, po którym odkładamy książkę i wracamy do wygodnego przekonania, że nas to nie dotyczy.   To jest także nasza wojna o bezpieczeństwo, niezależność i prawo do decydowania o własnym państwie. Nie ogłaszam tym zdaniem stanu wojny ani nie zrównuję naszego codziennego życia z losem ludzi pod ostrzałem. Mówię o interesie Polski. Już w deklaracji szczytu NATO z 2014 roku zapisano, że niepodległa, suwerenna i stabilna Ukraina ma kluczowe znaczenie dla bezpieczeństwa euroatlantyckiego. Wniosek jest prosty: wspierając jej zdolność do obrony, nie robimy wyłącznie dobrego uczynku dla sąsiada. Chronimy również warunki, w których sami możemy żyć bez podporządkowania cudzej przemocy.   Otwórzmy wreszcie te szeroko zamknięte oczy. Ta historia nie zaczęła się 24 lutego 2022 roku. Rosja zajęła Krym i prowadziła działania zbrojne przeciwko Ukrainie już w 2014 roku. W tym samym roku NATO mówiło wprost o konieczności przeciwdziałania zagrożeniom hybrydowym, łączącym działania wojskowe i pozawojskowe, jawne i skryte. Nie było prostego przełącznika: najpierw tylko propaganda, a dopiero po 2022 roku wojna hybrydowa. Działania informacyjne są jednym z jej narzędzi. Rok 2022 przyniósł pełnoskalową inwazję, a nie narodziny całego mechanizmu.   Wystarczy przypomnieć rok 2021 i wykorzystywanie migrantów przez reżim białoruski do wywierania presji na Unię Europejską i jej państwa. Rada UE właśnie w związku z tą kampanią hybrydową rozszerzyła w listopadzie 2021 roku kryteria sankcji. To działo się przed pełnoskalową inwazją. Ludzkie cierpienie, granica, presja polityczna i przekaz informacyjny zostały połączone w jedno narzędzie oddziaływania. Wojna nie musi zaczynać się od oficjalnego komunikatu, po którym wszyscy uprzejmie przyjmują do wiadomości, że właśnie się zaczęła.   „Wojna kognitywna” brzmi jak termin z zamkniętej konferencji ekspertów. W praktyce chodzi o wpływanie na to, jak rozpoznajesz zagrożenia, komu ufasz i jakie decyzje podejmujesz. O rozbijanie zdolności społeczeństwa do wspólnej oceny rzeczywistości. NATO opisuje operacje informacyjne między innymi jako narzędzia siania wątpliwości, destabilizowania społeczeństw i podważania zaufania. W takim mechanizmie nie trzeba przekonać odbiorcy, że Putin jest wspaniały. Wystarczy doprowadzić go do przekonania, że nikomu nie warto ufać, napadniętym nie należy pomagać, a każda próba obrony przed agresorem jest niebezpieczniejsza od samego agresora.   Nie rozmawiamy jednak wyłącznie o komentarzach w internecie. 8 maja 2024 roku CERT Polska opisał szeroko zakrojoną kampanię szkodliwego oprogramowania wymierzoną w polskie instytucje rządowe. CERT Polska i wojskowy zespół reagowania na incydenty powiązały ją na podstawie wskaźników technicznych z aktywnością APT28, kojarzoną z rosyjskim wywiadem wojskowym GRU. Celem były polskie instytucje, nie odległe ukraińskie okopy. Kiedy ktoś opowiada, że rosyjska agresja nas nie dotyczy, powinien najpierw przeczytać, przed kim i przed czym nasi specjaliści muszą chronić państwowe systemy.  A teraz konkretny adres: Marywilska 44 w Warszawie. Pożar z 12 maja 2024 roku zniszczył centrum handlowe z około 1400 sklepami i punktami usługowymi. W komunikacie z 12 maja 2025 roku Prokuratura Krajowa podała, że według ustaleń śledztwa było to podpalenie dokonane na zlecenie wywiadu Federacji Rosyjskiej. Opisała również polecenie nagrania pożaru i przekazania materiału do publikacji na rosyjskich portalach propagandowych. W jednym zdarzeniu widać więc oba elementy: fizyczne zniszczenie oraz wykorzystanie go do oddziaływania na opinię publiczną. To ustalenia śledztwa, nie mój wymysł i nie zastępstwo dla wyroku wobec konkretnych osób. W tej sprawie wskazano także podejrzanych będących obywatelami Ukrainy. Ich obywatelstwo nie zmienia opisanego przez śledczych rosyjskiego zleceniodawcy. Obciążanie całego narodu zamiast ustalania odpowiedzialności konkretnych ludzi nie jest patriotyzmem. Jest rezygnacją z myślenia.   Kolejny przykład: 29 grudnia 2025 roku przeprowadzono skoordynowane cyberataki na co najmniej 30 farm wiatrowych i fotowoltaicznych, przedsiębiorstwo produkcyjne oraz dużą elektrociepłownię dostarczającą ciepło prawie pół milionowi odbiorców. CERT Polska opisał ich cel jako destrukcyjny. Infrastruktura wykorzystana przez napastników w znacznym stopniu pokrywała się z infrastrukturą grupy znanej między innymi jako Static Tundra, którą badacze Cisco Talos wiążą z rosyjską Federalną Służbą Bezpieczeństwa. Trzeba też powiedzieć uczciwie, czego atakujący nie osiągnęli: nie przerwali bieżącej produkcji energii w zaatakowanych farmach ani dostaw ciepła z elektrociepłowni. Próba uruchomienia programu niszczącego dane w elektrociepłowni została zablokowana. To powód, żeby docenić obronę, a nie dowód, że zagrożenie było zmyślone.   Dlatego zdanie „Rosja już nas atakuje” nie jest publicystycznym straszakiem. NATO wprost opisuje rosyjską kampanię działań hybrydowych przeciwko sojusznikom, obejmującą sabotaż infrastruktury, cyberataki, dezinformację, wrogie wpływy polityczne i prowokacje. Skala oraz charakter tych działań są inne niż wojna na ukraińskim froncie. Ale z tego, że nie żyjemy tak jak mieszkańcy ostrzeliwanych miast, nie wynika, że pozostajemy poza zasięgiem agresora. Można nie słyszeć artylerii i nadal być celem.   W czerwcu 2026 roku Europejska Służba Działań Zewnętrznych przedstawiła raport opisujący rosyjskie operacje informacyjne wymierzone w poparcie dla Ukrainy i jej integracji europejskiej. Wskazała między innymi produkowanie treści przy użyciu sztucznej inteligencji, wzmacnianie ich na wielu platformach, wyrywanie wypowiedzi z kontekstu oraz rozpowszechnianie fałszywych opowieści o Ukraińcach jako zagrożeniu. Jednocześnie odróżniła tę działalność od uprawnionej debaty o korupcji, reformach i sposobie rządzenia. I właśnie tego rozróżnienia trzeba pilnować: krytyczne pytanie nie jest rosyjską operacją. Ale operacja nie przestaje nią być dlatego, że ubrano ją w pozór zatroskanego pytania.   Do tej części PiS-landii, która obronę polskich interesów pomyliła z nakręcaniem pogardy wobec Ukrainy, mam więc pytanie: co właściwie chcecie osiągnąć? Skuteczniejszą kontrolę pomocy, lepsze umowy gospodarcze, uczciwe rozliczanie pieniędzy? To są konkretne postulaty i można o nich poważnie rozmawiać. Czy może chodzi już tylko o to, żeby każdą sprawę przerobić na kolejną porcję nienawiści do politycznych przeciwników? Polska racja stanu nie może polegać na odwracaniu własnego stanowiska za każdym razem, kiedy zmienia się gospodarz kancelarii premiera. Przypomnijcie sobie 15 marca 2022 roku. Do Kijowa pojechali Mateusz Morawiecki i Jarosław Kaczyński. Spotkali się z władzami napadniętego państwa i okazali Ukrainie wsparcie. Uważam, że zrobili wtedy rzecz słuszną. Nie trzeba popierać PiS, żeby to przyznać. Ale konsekwencja obowiązuje w obie strony: pomoc Ukrainie nie była patriotyzmem wyłącznie wtedy, kiedy na zdjęciu stali wasi politycy. Nie staje się zdradą, gdy za jej kontynuacją opowiada się ktoś z innego obozu. Bezpieczeństwo Polski nie jest własnością żadnej partii.   Nie twierdzę, że każdy wyborca PiS powiela rosyjską propagandę. Nie twierdzę też, że każdy człowiek krytyczny wobec ukraińskich władz działa na zlecenie Moskwy. Takie zbiorowe oskarżenia byłyby dokładnie tym uproszczeniem, które trzeba zwalczać. Twierdzę natomiast, że patriotyczne deklaracje nie zwalniają z odpowiedzialności za rozpowszechniane treści. Gdy ktoś bez sprawdzenia udostępnia materiał podsycający nienawiść do całego narodu, nie powinien zasłaniać się flagą ani partyjną legitymacją. Powinien umieć pokazać źródło. I przyznać się do błędu, kiedy materiał okazuje się kłamstwem. Można twardo domagać się prawdy o Wołyniu, ekshumacji, godnego pochówku i uczciwej pamięci. Można bronić interesów polskich rolników, przewoźników i przedsiębiorców. Można żądać kontroli każdego publicznego wydatku. Żaden z tych postulatów nie wymaga pogardy wobec ukraińskiego dziecka w polskiej szkole. Żaden nie wymaga usprawiedliwiania rosyjskiej agresji. Żaden nie daje prawa do obciążenia przypadkowej uchodźczyni odpowiedzialnością za wszystkie decyzje władz w Kijowie i całą historię stosunków polsko-ukraińskich. Ukrainiec nie musi być święty, żeby mieć prawo żyć. A Polak nie staje się patriotą tylko dlatego, że go nienawidzi. Tu wracamy do Twardocha. Do człowieka, który nie ograniczył zaangażowania do napisania książki: organizował zbiórki i osobiście dostarczał ukraińskiemu wojsku samochody, drony oraz wyposażenie. Można nie lubić jego poglądów i sposobu wypowiadania się. Nie trzeba podpisywać się pod każdym zdaniem autora, żeby uznać różnicę między realną pomocą a internetową pozą. Literatura nie zastępuje analizy bezpieczeństwa, a działalność pomocowa nie daje nieomylności. Ale obie potrafią zmusić do wyjścia poza własną wygodę.   Właśnie dlatego „Null” warto potraktować jako zaproszenie do trudniejszej rozmowy, a nie następny rekwizyt partyjnej awantury. Czy potrafimy patrzeć na ludzi inaczej niż przez gotową etykietę? Czy umiemy rozpoznać różnicę między obroną własnego interesu a odreagowywaniem złości na słabszym? Czy mamy odwagę sprawdzić również taki materiał, który idealnie pasuje do naszych poglądów? Najłatwiej ogłosić, że przejrzało się propagandę przeciwnika. Znacznie trudniej zauważyć, że samemu właśnie udostępniło się cudze kłamstwo. Polacy, otwórzmy oczy, zanim znowu odruchowo klikniemy „udostępnij”. Sprawdźmy datę, autora, oryginalną wypowiedź i kontekst. Nie pytajmy wyłącznie, czy materiał uderza w polityka, którego nie lubimy. Zapytajmy, czy jest prawdziwy. I czy pomaga nam zrozumieć rzeczywistość, czy tylko dostarcza kolejnego człowieka do znienawidzenia. Obywatelska samodzielność nie polega na nieufności wobec wszystkiego poza własną bańką. Gratulacje, Szczepanie Twardochu. A tym, którzy nadal powtarzają, że to wyłącznie ukraińska sprawa, odpowiadam: nie chcę wojny w Polsce. Właśnie dlatego nie zgadzam się na lekceważenie agresora, który już działa przeciwko naszemu bezpieczeństwu. Nie musimy kochać Ukrainy, żeby rozumieć, dlaczego niepodległy sąsiad jest lepszy od sąsiada podporządkowanego Moskwie. To jest także nasza wojna o prawo do spokojnego życia. A narracja Kremla nie staje się polską racją stanu tylko dlatego, że ktoś opowiada ją po polsku i dokleił sobie biało-czerwoną flagę. Возраст усложняет процесс, структура слишком рыхлая, жертвы часто не хотят помогать следствию, особенно, если хакеры похищают у них криптовалюту, документы и другие средства сомнительного происхождения.   Между этими брендами мира больше нет. ShinyHunters, Scattered Spider и LAPSUS$ уже не отдельные лавки, а сменяемые бренды одного слоя, который исследователи называют The Com: похожие люди, общие приёмы, общий способ ведения дел. В 2025-м они на время собрались под одной крышей Scattered Lapsus$ Hunters, а потом снова разъехались по разным кличкам. Ресурс, за который здесь дерутся, не сервер. Это доступ к жертве, канал слива, ресурсы и возможность повесить на взлом своё имя. Операторы адреса, связанного с ShinyHunters, сами объяснили Reuters падение сайта саботажем конкурентов и междоусобными конфликтами. Когда бренд можно украсть за ночь, союз держится, только пока он выгоден и монетизируется.  Внутри каждой такой компании уже сидит человек, который говорит со следствием и сливает соучастников. Вспомним громкие дела последних лет:   В Британии Owen Flowers и Thalha Jubair получили по пять с половиной лет за атаку на Transport for London. В США Noah Urban, известный как Sosa, в 2025-м получил десять лет. Tyler Buchanan из Британии арестовали в аэропорту Пальма-де-Мальорка, в апреле 2026-го он признал вину в американском суде. Peter Stokes, гражданин США и Эстонии, сел в Хельсинки в апреле 2026-го с двумя дисками по 2 ТБ в багаже, когда садился на рейс в Японию. География арестов — Иордания, Нидерланды, Британия, США, Испания, Финляндия — это не одна спецоперация. Это цена рыхлой структуры: каждый задержанный уносит с собой чужие имена, адреса и фамилии.   Все ключевые участники группировок собирают друг на друга компромат, враждуют, и когда доходит до арестов, они сдают всех.   Этого нет у группировок, которые сидят на государственном пайке. Российские кластеры, которые Запад связывает с ГРУ и СВР, — Sandworm, APT28, APT29 — не торгуют брендом и не сливают друг друга из-за личной вражды. Северокорейский Lazarus считает выручку в пользу режима, а не личного кошелька. Китайские группы уровня APT41 умеют совмещать заказ и побочный заработок, но спор за добычу там решает куратор, а не голосование в Discord или эмоции. Жёсткая дисциплина покупается задачей, бюджетом и страхом перед своим государством с системой жёсткого наказания. У ShinyHunters нет ни того, ни другого. Поэтому арест одного администратора в Аммане для них опаснее, чем для государственной службы потеря одного оператора: там человека заменят по штату, здесь вместе с ним правоохранителям уходит вся информация и компромат.  Rey в этой схеме был не рядовым исполнителем эксплойта, а человеком у рубильника публичной части: форумы, каналы слива, переговоры и контактные данные. Такие фигуры редко бывают незаменимы технически. Они незаменимы как память группы и лицо бренда — кто писал, кто платил, куда уходили архивы. Если источники Reuters правы и эта память сейчас открыта следователям, пауза в каналах ShinyHunters — не ребрендинг. Это момент, когда следующий псевдоним уже не может получить достаточное количество информации для формирования новой группы на базе старых, отработанных схем и цепочка не только посыпется дальше, но и затянется пауза в новых делах, ведь многие лягут на дно и будут ждать. Их тем временем будут вытеснять группировки с более жёсткой, государственной дисциплиной.   ---

Mostly, yes — and that's the uncomfortable part. The US has never extradited anyone for ransomware, and the countries where these crews actually live — Russia, Iran, North Korea — won't touch them. So the realistic worst case for a hacker is losing access to their crypto wallet, not prison.The one exception is sanctions evasion. North Korea's Lazarus Group launders crypto through mixers, and the US has actually seized wallets and charged people for that. But that's a narrow slice — most ransomware crews aren't sanctioned, so they just keep operating.The real risk isn't law enforcement, it's other criminals. Rival gangs, scammers, or even their own partners will steal their wallets if they get sloppy. That's why they use mixers and layered wallets — not to hide from the FBI, but from each other.  Because the economics flipped. Ransomware-as-a-service means anyone can buy a kit for a few hundred dollars, and the payouts are enormous — a single breach can net millions, while the cost of getting caught is usually just a VPN and a new alias.On the defense side, most companies still run on decades-old software with unpatched vulnerabilities, and identity is the weak link. One stolen password or one compromised employee account can unlock an entire network, which is why social engineering keeps working even when the firewalls don't fail.The asymmetry is brutal: attackers only need to find one way in, defenders have to block every single one. 소버린 글로벌마켓 모닝브리핑 2026-10-05 (월)      ─────────────────      1. 유럽 국채 전염 우려와 미 국채 종가 4일째 미확인 (Sovereign Rates & Liquidity) 블룸버그는 유럽 국채 매도세가 15년 전 재정위기의 기억을 소환하며 전염(Contagion) 위험을 키우고 있다고 경고했습니다. 파라마운트의 520억 달러 차입이 막대한 금리 비용을 치렀다는 분석이 제기되었습니다.  2. 호르무즈 선박 피격 재개와 수송 회복 서사의 정면 충돌 (Middle East Geopolitics & Energy) WSJ와 CNBC는 미 당국자를 인용해 호르무즈 해협 인근에서 유조선에 대한 추가 피격 공격이 재개되었다고 보도했습니다. 반면 NYT 등은 중동 원유 출하량이 전쟁 이전 수준으로 반등했다고 전해, 이란 협상대표의 "7개 조건 전 재개방 불가" 강경 발언과 맞물려 실물 공급망의 안도감과 군사적 타격 위협이 정면으로 충돌했습니다.  3.키이우 교량 타격과 미·러 우크라이나 석유 거래설 (Global Multi-Front Geopolitics) 러시아군이 키이우 교량을 이틀 연속 공격하고 우크라이나가 로봇 기습 공세로 맞서는 등 동유럽 전선(GEO-RU-001)의 실물 교전이 격화되었습니다. NYT는 미·러 협상 배후에 수십억 달러 규모의 석유 거래가 포함되었다고 타전했습니다.   4. AI 쏠림 경고와 금융권 AI 침해 WATCH 연장 (Tech Capex & Credit Friction) 블룸버그는 치솟는 국채 금리 속에서 월가의 위험 프리미엄이 압축된 채 AI로만 자금이 쏠리는 기형적 루프를 경고했습니다. 국내에서는 신한·국민·하나 등 5대 은행 AI 해킹 사태에 대한 추가 피해 보도는 없었으나, 공식 규명 및 피해 한정 발표가 부재하여 시스템 리스크에 대한 시그널이 공식 연장되었습니다.  5. 전세대출 총량 제외 완화와 대체공휴일 휴장 관망 (Korea Macro & Asymmetry) 정부가 청년특례 전세대출을 가계대출 총량 규제에서 전격 제외하며 취약 차주에 대한 미세 완화책을 내놓았습니다. 한국 시장이 개천절 대체공휴일로 휴장한 가운데, 한전 직원 정보 노출 및 162조 원 규모 미래대응기금 관련 국회 갈등이 이어지며 대외 금리 발작에 대한 국내 펀더멘털의 방어력이 시험대에 올랐습니다.  ─────────────────      "기본값은 No Action. 조건이 바뀌면 움직입니다."

AI 해커 한 세력에 한국 금융이 줄줄이 뚫렸다  당국은 중국발 오픈소스 침투도구 ARTEX 흔적과 같은 IP 루트를 보고, 동일 세력의 AI 자동화 공격으로 보고 있어. 신한은행 공격 IP를 공유해 점검했더니 국민·하나·부산은행에서도 같은 길이 나왔어. 은행 앱이 아니라 서브시스템이 타깃이야. 긴급 점검회의엔 금융위·금감원, 은행·보험·카드 협회에 과기정통부·개보위·경찰청까지 모였고, 당국은 AI 에이전트가 여러 기관을 짧은 기간에 대량 공격할 수 있다고 보고 있어.  6월 금융연구원 세미나에서 이미 AI 에이전트 하나가 은행권 DB를 칠 수 있다고 경고했는데, 그 시나리오가 현실로 온 거야. 보안업계는 다음이 정부·공공기관일 수 있다고 보고, 청와대는 조사와 대책 지시를 내렸어. 이억원 금융위원장은 AI 해킹 가능성을 배제할 수 없다고 했어.  한 도구가 금융권 전체를 같은 속도로 흔든 사고야.  #AI해킹 #금융보안 #ARTEX

[한국 5대 상업은행, 사상 최초로 인공지능(AI) 기반 해킹 의심 공격 피해…3곳에서 고객 정보 유출 발생]  한국의 5대 주요 상업은행 모두가 인공지능으로 추정되는 해킹 공격을 받아 그중 3곳에서 고객 데이터 유출 피해를 입었습니다. 한국 금융업계에서 5대 은행이 동시에 공격을 받은 것은 이번이 처음입니다. BNK 부산은행은 아웃소싱 직원 11명의 개인정보가 유출됐고, KB국민은행은 고객 119명의 정보가 유출됐다고 밝혔으며, 하나은행 역시 고객 89명의 정보가 유출됐다고 발표했습니다.
중국AI로 한국 금융기관 정부기관 해킹 AI를 사용한다면 막을 방법없다 미국AI는 자신의 해킹 흔적도 지운다 중국도 곧 되겠지

미국에선 AI 해킹 군단을 만드는 회사에 3,700억 원이 몰렸고, 한국 은행들은 같은 종류의 공짜 AI 도구에 뚫렸습니다.  Google에 보안회사를 8조 원 가까이에 판 Kevin Mandia가 새로 차린 Armadin은 AI 에이전트 여러 개가 떼로 붙어서 기업 서버를 먼저 공격해 보는 회사입니다. 몸값은 3조 5천억 원이 넘었습니다.  같은 일을 하는 프로그램이 중국어권 깃허브에는 이미 무료로 올라와 있습니다. 금융보안원은 최근 은행 연쇄 해킹에 그런 도구가 쓰였다고 확인했습니다.  공격하는 쪽은 AI를 공짜로 쓰는데, 막는 쪽은 수천억짜리 회사를 사 와야 하는 구조입니다. 한국 금융사 보안 예산이 이 속도를 따라갈 수 있을지가 이번 해킹이 던진 진짜 숙제입니다.

sample_tweets.text: On 13 August 2017, Neymar opened his PSG account with a goal and an assist in a 3–0 away win over Guingamp.  Lucas Deaux, the defender who had stood in his way, later remarked that he had never seen a player like this before. Just weeks later, on 20 August, the forward produced two goals and two assists against Toulouse to send his side away with a 6–2 scoreline. The form continued into September when, on 30 September, another 6–2 triumph over Bordeaux saw Neymar add two more goals to his tally. By then, he had already established himself as the club's most influential player, relishing a freedom and influence he had not known at Barcelona.  PSG topped their Champions League group table as Neymar struck six goals across six matches against Celtic, Bayern Munich and Anderlecht. In December, the CIES Football Observatory produced a team of Europe's finest performers since the start of the season, and Neymar was included alongside his fellow PSG teammates Verratti and Alves. Twice in his professional career, Neymar found himself named in the FIFA FIFPRO World 11.  He was the primary catalyst in PSG reclaiming the Ligue 1 crown after Monaco's previous season victory, a feat that earned him the Ligue 1 Player of the Year accolade. Despite that notable run concluding in late February 2018 when a metatarsal injury to his right foot was picked up in a league match against Marseille, preventing him from taking part in PSG's vital second leg of their Champions League tie with Real Madrid, who then went on to eliminate them.  By August 2018, Neymar was back on the pitch, opening PSG's account in the new campaign with a goal in a 3–0 home win over Caen on 12 August. The goals kept coming; on 29 September he netted twice in a 3–0 league victory against Nice, and by November he had found the net again to seal a 2–1 win over Lille after the visitors had pulled one back with a late penalty. That streak of form saw PSG lock up a 12th straight win from the opening day of the Ligue 1 campaign, setting a new all-time benchmark for any side in the big five European leagues at the time. Then, on 23 January, almost twelve months since the injury that had ended his campaign, Neymar re-injured the metatarsal in his right foot while PSG secured their Coupe de France victory over Strasbourg.  After recovering from his foot injury to feature in the 2019 Coupe de France final against Rennes, where he provided the assist and scored PSG's second goal following a stunning chip that had put them 2-0 ahead, the match descended into chaos when a Presnel Kimpembe own goal allowed the Bretons to draw 2-2 and ultimately prevail on penalties, while Mbappé was dismissed before the shootout and Neymar appeared to strike a spectator on the chin as he climbed the steps of the Stade de France to collect his runner-up medal. The match descended into chaos as Kylian Mbappe was sent off, and Rennes eventually claimed victory in a penalty shootout won 6-5 by the underdogs. As he climbed the steps of the Stade de France to collect his runners-up medal, Neymar was confronted by a supporter who had been filming and insulting PSG players, and after a brief exchange of words he appears to have struck the man on the chin.  By the time the Ligue 1 trophy was secured on 21 April, Neymar kept contributing in the league, eventually winning his second title with the club and finishing as their second-top scorer with twenty-three goals in twenty-eight matches, trailing only Mbappé. The season, however, was far from smooth; injuries plagued him throughout, including a further blow in the summer that kept him away from Brazil's Copa América triumph in 2019, a campaign marred by both physical setbacks and off-pitch controversies that ultimately excluded him from the Ballon d'Or shortlist for the first time since 2010. Despite that exclusion, France Football recognised his contribution at the decade's close by naming him in their Team of the Decade for 2011–2020. Neymar's return to his boyhood club, Santos, is complete.  Was PSG's era defined by Neymar's brilliance, or would they have won the Champions League without the injuries?  #Neymar #ParisSaintGermain #BallinGodz

Nobody sat behind me or them 24/7 waiting for us to screw up.  Why should I manage an AI agent any differently?

Automations: scheduled prompts (morning list,      weekly meal ideas). Available without a paid agent plan for basic      schedules. Grok Bot (the always-on agent): a paid feature.      It runs multi-step jobs on its own cloud computer. Included with SuperGrok      (about $30/month) and with X Premium+ (about $40/month, which also includes      SuperGrok-level Grok access). Extra heavy use can be billed on top of the      weekly allowance. The developer API is separate and pay-per-token; a      subscription does not include API credits. How many bots? Start with zero custom bots. One shared free or SuperGrok login is enough for a household. If you later pay for Grok Bot, use one bot with a clear job (for example, “household planner: meals, shopping list, calendar reminders; never spend money or email anyone without asking”). Add a second only when the job is truly different. Docs recommend the smallest useful roster; vague “helper” bots waste the allowance. Initial setup Go to grok.com or the Grok app and      sign in with one family Google/X/Apple account you all can use. Use free      chat for a week. Keep questions short and specific (“3 cheap dinners from      chicken, rice, and frozen broccoli, under 30 minutes”). Only      upgrade if free limits get in the way. SuperGrok ($30)      or X Premium+ ($40) if you also want X features. Check the      plan page for your region before paying. If you      enable Grok Bot: New chat → Create new Bot → give it a name and a tight      job description → test one task → require approval before it sends mail or      changes accounts. Mistakes that raise cost Opening an      xAI API account and wiring bots to it for ordinary chat. API has no free      tier; flagship models are on the order of a few dollars per million      tokens, and long prompts or many daily calls add up fast. Huge      system prompts, pasting whole documents every time, or leaving max output      unlimited. One paid      plan per person instead of one shared login. Letting a      bot run unattended with access to email, bank, or shopping accounts. Assuming      Grok Bot usage and normal chat share the same meter—they are separate, and      overage is extra. For most homes, free chat plus one shared paid plan if needed stays in the $0–$30 range. API bots are for builders, not every day family help. x.ai/grok-bot/get-started. Bot management: docs.x.ai/grok-bot/bots. What can Super Grok do that a free Grok Bot cannot do besides translating my books into foreign languages (a chapter at a time; I love it)? Cost? Is research different? You mean free Grok chat versus SuperGrok. I’ll check the current plan differences, price, and how research is split. Free Grok and SuperGrok are the same chat product with different limits. There is no free Grok Bot. Grok Bot, the always-on agent with its own computer, starts at SuperGrok. SuperGrok is $30 a month, or $300 a year ($25 a month). That is the current price on x.ai/pricing. Higher tiers exist if you outgrow it: SuperGrok Plus is $100 a month; Heavy is about $300. X Premium+ is about $40 and includes SuperGrok-level Grok plus X features, if you want those too. What SuperGrok adds, beyond longer jobs like chapter-by-chapter translation? Frontier model access. The plan      page lists Grok 4.6. Free stays on the more limited models and hits caps      sooner. Much higher usage. Paid plans      use one shared weekly pool across chat, images, voice, and Build. Free has      “generous limits,” but long chapters and repeated work run into them.      Reports from the plan comparison put SuperGrok at about 5x longer chats;      xAI does not publish an exact message count. Grok Bot. Free cannot create      those agents. Expert mode. This is the deeper      research setting. Free real-time web and X search is marked Limited on the      comparison table; Expert is a SuperGrok feature, with higher limits than      free search. Image generation and video.      SuperGrok includes Imagine and HD 720p video up to about 30 seconds. 1080p      video is Plus, not the $30 plan. Longer voice conversations and      faster replies. Connectors to outside apps,      listed on the SuperGrok card. Research is the clearest quality difference. Free can still search the web and X, but it is capped and is not Expert mode. Expert is meant for longer, sourced investigations; SuperGrok also lets those runs go further before the allowance stops them. For a chapter translation, the practical difference is mostly length and how often you get stopped, not a separate translator. You do not get API credits with the subscription. Heavy bot or image use can still add overage once the weekly pool is gone. For book chapters plus ordinary family questions, the $30 plan is the one that removes the free caps; Plus is only worth it if you also want 1080p video or much higher volume. Grok Bot is xAI’s product. A Bot is a named AI teammate with its own job, conversation, and memory. It works on a persistent cloud computer (browser, always-on agent files, and terminal) and can keep going after you close the app. It is not the same thing as free Grok chat, and it is not the developer API.  You need a paid plan that includes it: SuperGrok, SuperGrok Plus, or SuperGrok Heavy, or a paid Cursor plan. Access is tied to a Cursor account; if you pay through SuperGrok, you link that subscription in the app. Bot usage has its own allowance, separate from normal Grok chat. Set one up Download the desktop app from x.ai/bot (macOS, Windows, or      Linux). Mobile setup is also available. Open it and sign in with      Cursor. If your access is from SuperGrok, link that account when asked      (Settings → Usage & Billing on desktop). On first launch it explains      Bots, the shared computer, and routines, then opens Meet a future      teammate. Pick a suggested teammate, or      choose Create your own and give it: a short name one primary job a description of how it should       work, including what it must not do Later bots: sidebar New (or      Cmd/Ctrl+N) → Create new Bot, then Edit Profile for name, label,      description, and avatar. A useful description is operational, not vague. Example: “Own the weekly household plan. Pull the calendar and shopping list, flag conflicts, and return a short list of decisions needed. Never email anyone or place an order without approval.” First task Give it an outcome, sources, limits, the deliverable, and when to stop for you. A safe first run is to attach a document and ask for a summary with dates and open questions, and tell it not to change the file. When it hits a login, open Agent Computer, take over, sign in yourself, then hand control back. That browser session stays on the shared computer, so other bots on the same account can use it. Supported apps can also be connected from Marketplace. Put lasting rules in the Bot description (“never send external messages without approval”). Put one-off instructions in the chat. When a process is stable, ask it to save a skill or create a routine. Practical limits Start with one bot that owns a whole outcome. Add another only when the work is a stable specialist role. Bots have separate chats, but they share one computer, files, and sign-ins — separate bots are not a security boundary. Deleting a bot removes its profile and routines; shared logins may remain. Hide a bot if you might need it later. Official setup: docs.x.ai/grok-bot/get-start…. Bot management: docs.x.ai/grok-bot/bots.

빌 게이츠의 ‘AI로 인해 10억 명이 사망할 수 있다’는 취지의 경고가 단순한 공포 마케팅으로만 치부할 일은 아닌 것 같다.  이번 금융권 해킹 사례를 보면 더 섬뜩하다.  기존 해킹은 사람이 취약점을 찾아 공격했다면, AI 에이전트는 정찰 → 취약점 탐색 → 침투 → 정보 수집까지 상당 부분을 스스로 수행할 수 있다.  실제로 이번 공격에서도 금융사의 핵심 시스템을 정면으로 뚫은 게 아니라, 외부와 내부망 사이의 ‘옆문’ 같은 DMZ 구간을 노렸다.  더 무서운 건 규모다. AI는 한두 곳이 아니라 수백 곳을 동시에 공격할 수 있는 능력을 갖춰가고 있다.  AI가 인간을 돕는 도구를 넘어 인간이 통제하기 어려운 공격 도구가 된다면 문제의 차원이 달라진다.  AI가 10억 명을 죽일 수 있다는 전망이 당장 현실이라는 얘기는 아니지만, 적어도 ‘허무맹랑한 소리’라고 치부하기에는 기술의 발전 속도가 너무 빠르다.  AI의 발전보다 중요한 건 그 AI를 누가, 어떻게 통제할 것인가다.

이번에 금융 해킹에 사용한 AI 해킹 도구 ARTEX를 도구를 사용한 IP 대역에서도 아직도 오픈 되어 있습니다. 이 모든 것이 다 공격에 사용하지는 않았지만, 모든 나라 IP 대역에서 공격이 들어올 가능성은 언제든지 있다는거죠.  중요한 것은 이 도구를 사용했냐라기 보다는, 본질적인 취약점을 개선해야죠?.. 이번에 뚫린 취약점은 그냥 일반 취약점 도구로 해도 다 뚫릴 취약점이었으니..

은행 고객 수만 명의 정보가 유출된 같은 주, 금융의 구조를 바꾸겠다던 블록체인 행사의 참석 규모는 오히려 줄었습니다.  신한은행에서는 약 2만 5천 명의 정보가 유출됐습니다. 공격 추정 서버에서 AI 침투 도구의 흔적이 발견됐지만, 실제 사용 여부는 아직 확인되지 않았습니다.  Web3도 안전지대는 아닙니다. Chainalysis는 AI가 소스코드가 공개·검증되지 않은 컨트랙트의 취약점 분석을 가속할 수 있다고 봤습니다. CertiK이 집계한 3분기 전체 보안 사고 손실은 약 12억 7천만 달러로, 전 분기보다 54.4% 늘었습니다. 국내 거래소의 상반기 거래지원 종료도 중복을 포함해 108건이었습니다.  같은 주 열린 KBW의 참석자는 주최 측 발표로 연인원 1만 2,500명이었습니다. 지난해는 2만 8천 명이었습니다. 그 무대에서도 AI 에이전트가 주요 화두였습니다.  돈도 AI로 향합니다. Crunchbase에 따르면 올해 1분기 글로벌 벤처 투자금의 80%가 AI에 몰렸습니다. The Block의 8월 초 누적 집계에서는 크립토 투자 건수가 전년 동기보다 약 64% 줄었습니다.  공격이 정교해질수록 신원과 소유, 권한을 검증할 필요는 더 커집니다. 그런데 그 가치를 오래 이야기해 온 Web3에는 관심과 자본이 충분히 따라오지 않습니다. 우리가 필요하다고 믿는 것과 시장이 돈을 쓰는 곳 사이의 거리가 느껴집니다.  가치를 말하는 것만으로는 돈이 움직이지 않습니다.  그 간극을 시장 탓으로만 돌릴 수도 없습니다. 탈중앙화와 검증 가능성을 내세웠다면, 정작 그것이 필요한 순간에 무엇을 지켜냈는지 답해야 합니다. 기록이 남는다는 것과 피해를 막는다는 것은 다른 일이기 때문입니다.  금융의 구조를 다시 짜겠다는 약속은 더 큰 목소리가 아니라, 공격 앞에서 실제로 버티는 시스템으로 증명돼야 합니다.
네이버는 마이홈이 2008년에 종료했는데 지금 뒤늦게 보니 이런 점에선 자유로워졌네  네이버가 보안 의식해서 링크를 바꾼 사례에는 블로그에 .me 도메인 폐지한 게 있다. 크롬 정책이 바뀌긴 했어도 억지로 유지할 수도 있었겠지만, 그러면 CSRF 취약점 여지가 생겨서.
AI가 가장 위협이 되는 부분 중 하나가 사이버 보안 관련이라 생각.  보안 패치를 계속 에이전트를 써서 자동화해보고 있는 중…  사람이 다룰수 없는 디테일한 부분까지 계속 매일 잡아주고 업데이트하고 있음…  라이브러리 취약점 업데이트도 거의 매일 나와서 사람이 이걸 하나하나 다 검토하고 할 수 있나 싶은 정도..

sample_tweets.text: Siehst Du, du hast keine Ahnung. Die RNA sollte die Impfung erzeugen, doch dazu sollte sie diesen Impfstoff in Deinen Zellen bilden. Doch wie dosiert man diesen Impfstoff wenn du selber zur Impfstofffabrik wirst? Anscheinend hast du dich nicht richtig informiert über dieses Zeug. Die modRNA sollte deine Zellen dazu anregen das Spikeprotein zu bilden, dieses sollten sie dann nach aussen präsentieren, damit sich Antikörper bilden. Doch das Problem ist eben es ist nicht mRNA sondern modRNA, der Unterschied liegt darin das dieses kein Uracil enthält, sondern Methylpseudouridin. Dies sorgt dafür das es zu einem Frameshift kommt, es bildet sich also nicht dieses Spikeprotein, sondern viele unterschiedliche Proteine. Es können sich also auch keine Antikörper gegen das Wildvirus bilden, es bilden sich Antikörper gegen Proteine welche in der Natur nicht vorkommen. Das ist wie eine DDoS Attacke auf das Immunsystem, das heisst es ist sogar wahrscheinlicher das man sich ansteckt weil das Immunsystem überfordert wird. Doch noch mehr dadurch das man in der letzten Barriere des Immunsystem beginnt, können Antikörper nichts ausrichten. Wenn nämlich Zellen ein fremdes Protein bilden, müssen sie von T-Killerzellen zerstört werden. Das heisst jedoch je mehr Zellen zerstört werden, desto höher die Wahrscheinlichkeit das sich Krebszellen bilden.  Noch mehr Informationen, wenn Herz oder Hirnzellen diese Proteine Bilden werden sie auch von T-Killerzellen zerstört. Das ist auch der Grund weshalb so viele Myokarditis bekommen haben. Doch Herz und Hirnzellen können nicht ersetzt werden, es bleibt nekrotisches Gewebe zurück. Ein Herzmuskel mit nekrotischem Gewebe ist nicht mehr so Leistungsfähig. Das heisst die Hälfte derer welche Myokarditis hatten sind in einigen Jahren auf dem Friedhof.  Das Ziel der klassischen Impfung ist genau das zu verhindern, das Zellen fremde Proteine bilden, denn der Schaden ist genau im zellulären Bereich am grössten. Eine virale Infektion ist schliesslich auch nur dann vorhanden wenn das Virus sich vermehrt. Doch Viren können sich nicht selbst vermehren, sie benötigen dazu eine Wirtszelle. Es ist somit keine Impfung sondern ein Zellgift.  Aber keine Sorge den Dachschaden hattest du schon vor der Impfung.

AI 트레이더 성장기 #013  AI 해킹이 만든 새로운 보안주 사이클?  오늘 신문에서 눈에 들어온 기사 하나.  신한은행 해킹 이후 드러난 건 의외로 핵심 뱅킹망이 아니었다. 공격 대상은 외부와 연결된 직원용 업무지원 시스템.  더 흥미로운 건 공격에 AI가 활용된 정황이 있다는 점이다.  AI를 이용하면 과거 사람이 하나씩 찾던 취약점을 훨씬 빠르게 탐색하고 반복 공격할 수 있다.  그렇다면 반대로 생각해봤다.  AI가 공격자의 생산성을 높인다면, 기업의 보안 투자도 구조적으로 늘어나는 것 아닐까?  AI와 함께 국내 보안주를 뜯어봤다.  * 지니언스 → NAC·EDR·제로트러스트 * 모니터랩 → 웹/API·클라우드 보안 * 파이오링크 → 웹방화벽·API·네트워크 보안 * 샌즈랩 → AI 기반 사이버 위협 분석 * 이글루 → AI 보안관제·자동 대응 * 라온시큐어 → 인증·접근통제  이번 사건에서 특히 눈여겨볼 키워드는 외부 노출 시스템 / 접근통제 / 인증 / AI 위협탐지.  다만 여기서 바로 매수하면 안 된다.  금융당국이 보안 강화를 주문했다고 해서 이 기업들에게 바로 신규 수주가 떨어지는 건 아니다.  그래서 이번에도 뉴스 → 관련주 매수가 아니라  뉴스 → 실제 수혜 사업 확인 → 거래대금 확인 → 차트 확인 → 주도주 선별  순서로 보려고 한다.  현재 내 관심종목은 지니언스 / 모니터랩 / 파이오링크 / 샌즈랩 / 이글루.  특히 지니언스는 올해 상반기 매출 249.2억, 영업이익 43.1억으로 전년 동기 대비 각각 +19.9%, +294.3%.  단순 테마주가 아니라 실제 실적이 따라오는지도 같이 볼 수 있는 종목이다.  AI 시대가 커질수록 AI 반도체와 데이터센터만 볼 게 아니라,  그 AI와 데이터를 지켜야 하는 보안 시장도 같이 커지는지 추적해볼 생각이다.  다음은 이 5개 종목의 차트를 비교해서 실제로 돈이 들어오기 시작한 종목이 있는지 찾아보자.  #AI트레이더 #사이버보안 #보안주 #지니언스 #샌즈랩

<사이버 안보, 사이버 방첩에 세계적 노하우를 가진 국정원이 나서 금융권 사이버해킹에 경찰, 중수청과 합동 대응해야 합니다>  통신사, 비트코인 업체, 외교부 산하기관에 이어 지금 AI에 의한 시중은행은 물론 제2금융권까지 사이버 해킹 공격 및 개인정보 유출이 동시다발적으로 발생한 것이 확인되었습니다.   경찰청 사이버테러수사대에서 내사를 시작했지만 사이버 범죄는 이제 막 출범한 중수청도 소관입니다.   국정원은 사이버 안보 및 국제 네트워크에 세계 최고의 경험, 기술, 인적 자원을 보유하고 있습니다.  국가안보를 위협하는 사이버 테러는 물론 특히 9월 29일 공포된 국정원법 개정으로 국제, 국가배후 사이버 해킹이 의심되는 경우, 국정원이 선제적으로 정보를 수집, 배포할 수 있도록 하였습니다.   현재 유출된 개인 정보는 다크웹 암시장에서 거래되어 제2, 제3의 국가적, 개인적 피해를 야기할 수도 있습니다.   개정된 국정원법 시행까지 3개월이 남았지만 작금의 사태를 테러로 규정하고 국정원을 포함한 3개 기관이 신속하게 공조, 배후를 규명해서 국민의 불안감을 해소시켜야 한다고 거듭  강력, 촉구합니다.

🚨 은행권 전방위 AI 해킹에 경찰 움직임  신한은행, KB국민은행 등 금융권에서 잇따라 보안 사고가 불거진 가운데 경찰도 관련 사건에 대한 확인에 들어갔습니다.  여기서 봐야 할 건 단순히 “몇 명의 개인정보가 유출됐냐” 가 아닙니다.  은행이라는 곳이 뚫렸다는 것 자체 심각하게 봐야합니다.  최근 기업, 통신사, 금융권까지 보안 사고가 계속해서 터지고 있습니다.  특히 AI가 발전하면서 피싱·악성코드·사회공학 공격 역시 더 빠르고 정교해질 수 있는 환경이 만들어지고 있습니다.  AI 시대에 가장 빠르게 가치가 올라가는 분야가 오히려 사이버 보안일 수도 있겠다는 생각이 듭니다.  이제는 “내 개인정보는 이미 공공재다”라는 농담이 마냥 농담처럼 들리지도 않네요.  진짜 보안에 돈 써야 할 때 입니다.  화이트해커가 필요한 시점이네요

sample_tweets.text: < 「全금융권 긴급 점검회의」 소집 - 금융권 사이버 침해, 최고수준의 경각심 갖고 신속‧총력 대응하겠습니다. > ​ 최근 잇따라 발생한 금융권 사이버 침해사고의 심각성을 감안하여, 연휴기간중이지만 오늘 제 주재로 과기부, 개보위, 경찰청 등 관계부처와 금감원, 금보원, 그리고 全금융권 CEO들이 참석한  「全금융권 긴급 점검회의」를 소집하였습니다.  당국은 첫 사고 접수 직후 신속한 현장조사에 착수했으며, 파악된 위협 정보를 즉각 전파해 선제적 자체 점검을 지시하는 등 확산 방지에 전력을 다하고 있습니다.  이러한 선제적 조치에 더해, 국민의 불안감을 차단하고 완벽한 소비자 보호를 이루기 위해 全금융권에도 최고 수준의 경각심을 갖고 신속하게 총력 대응해줄 것을 당부했습니다.  향후 유사사례 발생 시에는 엄중하게 책임을 묻도록 하겠습니다.   금융의 근간은 신뢰이며, 보안은 결코 비용이 아닙니다. 국민의 신뢰를 지키기 위한 가장 기본적인 ‘투자’입니다. 이번 일련의 사고를 단순 수습에 그치지 않고, 우리 금융권의 정보보안 체계를 한 단계 더 높이는 뼈아픈 계기로 삼겠습니다.  ​ 국민 여러분께서 안심하고 금융서비스를 이용하실 수 있도록, 범정부와 全금융권이 비상한 각오로 총력 대응해 나가겠습니다.  #금융위원회 #이억원금융위원장 #사이버보안 #긴급점검회의 #금융보안 #소비자보호 #AI방어체계

1. AGI 선언 OpenAI 사장 Greg Brockman이 a16z 인터뷰에서 말했다. "AGI라고 부르는 게 꽤 합리적이다." 기준은 '24시간 일관되게 돌아가는 시스템'. OpenAI의 AGI 정의는 '인간보다 전반적으로 똑똑한 시스템'이다. 다만 "해당되는지는 독자가 판단하라"며 여지를 남겼다.  2. GPT-6 Astra와 사이버 9월 3일 공개된 GPT-6 Astra는 사이버 능력에서 'critical' 등급을 받았다. Brockman은 자기 웹사이트 보안 점검 일화를 공개했다. 13개 취약점이 발견됐고 45분 만에 패치됐다.  3. 1만 개 에이전트의 나비에-스톡스 Navier-Stokes 문제에 1만 개 에이전트를 투입한 사례, 컴퓨터 사용 시스템까지. 에이전트가 실제 일을 해내는 시대가 됐다는 주장이다.  4. 방어자의 시간 사이버 영역에선 공격자보다 방어자가 먼저 이득을 볼 수 있다고 했다. OpenAI는 프로덕션 엔지니어의 25%를 방어에 배치했고, 수도·전력·지역은행을 위한 10억 달러 규모 'Daybreak' 프로그램을 내놨다.  총평 "AGI가 왔다"는 선언치고 근거는 에이전트 실무 능력에 쏠려 있다. Hassabis가 과학적 발견을 기준으로 삼는 것과 대조적이다. 정의가 다르면 결론이 달라진다. 그럼에도 사이버 방어에 10억 달러를 쏟는 건, 능력 향상이 곧바로 안보 이슈가 된다는 걸 보여준다. 이 인터뷰가 나온 같은 주에 아모데이가 속도 조절을 촉구했다는 점도 함께 봐야 한다.  piped.video/watch?v=IJn8cagM…

[한국어자막] 순다르 피차이 Google I/O 2026 대담 — 에이전트, 사이버보안, 오픈소스, 컴퓨팅 병목  "우리 모두 이 레이스 컨디션만은 어떻게든 피해야 해요."  Google I/O 2026 무대에서 매튜 버먼이 순다르 피차이와 나눈 30분 대담입니다. 피차이는 에이전트가 웹을 쓰는 방식의 핵심이 되겠지만, DMV 서류 18칸 채우기 같은 귀찮은 일은 에이전트에 맡기고 쇼핑이나 탐색처럼 즐거운 일은 사람이 직접 하는 식으로 나뉠 것이라고 봅니다. 그래서 사용자가 통제권과 투명성을 느끼게 만드는 것이 먼저라는 입장.  보안 쪽에서는 Mythos를 AI 사이버 능력의 변곡점으로 꼽고, 취약점 탐지부터 패치·배포까지 자동화하는 CodeMender를 내부에서 쓰고 있다고 밝힙니다. 최전선을 크게 바꾸는 모델은 보안 업계의 패치 유예 관행처럼 정부와 협력해 단계적으로 공개해야 한다는 것. 자기개선 AI 경쟁은 한 회사가 아니라 사회 전체가 논의할 문제라는 결론.  · 에이전트: 귀찮은 일은 위임, 사용자 통제가 전제 · 보안: Mythos 이후 CodeMender·Wiz로 자동 방어 · 오픈소스: Gemma는 계속, 대형 프런티어 모델은 비공개 · Flash: 수십억 사용자와 기업 에이전트의 비용 효율 · 컴퓨팅: 수요가 공급 초과, 전력·부품·인허가까지 모든 계층이 병목  게시자: @Dhruvkumar16797 / 화자: 순다르 피차이, 매튜 버먼 / 출처: 유튜브 Matthew Berman, Google I/O 2026 대담 (2026-05-20)

한국 금융위원회, 일련의 사이버 보안 사고 및 데이터 유출 사태와 관련하여 일요일 긴급회의 개최 예정. 이억원 금융위원장, 보안 침해 사례 검토 및 대응 방안 논의할 것.  신한, KB국민, 하나, BNK부산은행 및 예가람저축은행에서 데이터 유출이 확인되었으며, 약 4만 명의 고객이 피해를 입은 것으로 나타남; 현대캐피탈 또한 146명의 주택담보대출 대리인과 관련된 데이터 유출 사례를 보고함.

금융권 보안 핵심 4요소, 무엇이 가장 중요할까? (중요도 순위)  최신 사이버 보안의 관점에서 가장 근본적이고 파급력이 큰 순서대로 정리했습니다. 방어의 '기초 뼈대'부터 '행동 속도'로 이어지는 순서입니다.  1위: 제로 트러스트 (Zero Trust) 기반 망분리 역할: 기초 공사이자 최후의 보루   이유: 보안에서 가장 중요한 것은 '뚫려도 피해를 최소화하는 것'입니다. AI가 아무리 뛰어나도, EDR이 감지해도 이미 전체 망이 연결되어 있다면 늦습니다. "아무도 믿지 않고 매번 검증한다"는 시스템 구조 자체를 바꾸는 것이 0순위 과제입니다.  2위: EDR (엔드포인트 탐지 및 대응) 역할: 내부의 적을 찾는 정밀 CCTV   이유: 외부 방어선(방화벽)은 언젠가 뚫린다는 전제가 필요합니다. 해커가 내부에 들어왔을 때, 시스템 구석구석을 돌아다니는(횡적 이동) 것을 가장 먼저 발견하고 즉각 격리하는 실질적인 핵심 감시망입니다.  3위: AI vs AI (AI 위협 탐지 및 대응) 역할: 미지의 공격을 예측하는 레이더   이유: 제로 트러스트와 EDR이 잘 갖춰져 있어도, 해커가 AI를 써서 정상적인 활동처럼 위장하면 탐지하기 어렵습니다. 기존에 없던 새로운 패턴의 이상 징후를 실시간으로 잡아내려면 수비수에게도 AI 두뇌가 필수입니다.  4위: SOAR 및 24시간 자동 관제 역할: 인간의 한계를 넘는 초격차 스피드   이유: 위 1~3위의 방어 체계가 위협을 찾아내더라도, 사람이 수동으로 버튼을 눌러 대응하면 심야 시간에는 무용지물입니다. 탐지된 위협을 1초 만에 자동으로 차단하고 격리하는 '행동 대장' 역할로서 시스템의 완성도를 높입니다.  요약 1. 제로 트러스트로 절대 안 뚫리는 방 구조를 만들고  2. EDR로 방마다 CCTV를 달고 3. AI로 CCTV 영상을 정밀 분석한 뒤 4. SOAR가 침입자를 1초 만에 자동 포획하는 흐름입니다!  #보안우선순위 #제로트러스트 #사이버보안 #정보보안 #보안담당자 #IT지식 #테크트렌드

sample_tweets.text: 한 줄 요약  ‘검찰의 민영화, ㅈ됐음’  요즘 대형로펌들 보면 디지털 포렌식 센터에 자체 조사팀까지 따로 꾸리더라.  예전엔 수사기관이 하던 일을 이젠 돈 많은 사람이 먼저 돈 주고 하는 거.  근데 일반인은? 사기 당해도 가족이 큰 사고를 당해도 그냥 수사기관 순서 올 때까지 기다려야 됨  이게 좀 이상한 게 검찰 권한 줄이겠다고 시작한 일이 결국 돈 있는 사람들만 ‘사설 수사팀’을 따로 가질 수 있는 구조로 가는 거 같단 말이지  공공 수사력은 약해지고 그 빈자리를 대형로펌이 돈 받고 채우는 거면 이거 사실상 검찰의 민영화 아니야?

최근 자영업자 커뮤니티를 흔들어놓은 '배달 음식 상습 협박범 자멸 사건'임.  소상공인 식당에 음식 주문을 넣고 "음식에서 바퀴벌레가 나왔다"며 사진을 보내 환불과 치료비 명목으로 매번 수십만 원을 요구하던 상습범이 있었음.  사장님이 사과하며 돈을 보내주려 하자, 이 상습범은 "인터넷에 악성 리뷰 올리고 위생과에 신고해서 영업정지 시키겠다"며 추가로 현금 200만 원을 요구하며 협박함.  근데 이 식당 사장님의 정체가 전직 IT 보안 및 디지털 포렌식 전문가였음.  사장님은 상습범이 보내온 바퀴벌레 사진의 원본 파일 메타데이터(EXIF)를 곧바로 추출해 분석함.  분석 결과, 해당 사진은 2019년 해외 블로그에서 다운로드된 이미지였고, 상습범이 조작해서 계속 재탕하고 있던 거였음.  여기서 그치지 않고 사장님은 인근 지역 자영업자 단톡방에 해당 번호와 계좌를 공유했고, 동일한 패턴으로 피해를 입은 업주 28명을 끌어모음.  28명의 피해 사례와 포렌식 증거 자료를 완벽하게 정리해서 경찰에 고소장을 접수함.  경찰 수사가 시작되자 상습범은 "그냥 말다툼이었을 뿐이다"라며 오리발을 내밀었지만, 집 압수수색에서 수십 개 업체로부터 갈취한 내역과 장부가 그대로 적발됨.  결국 상습 공갈 및 사기 혐의로 구속되어 실형을 선고받았고, 피해 사장님들의 집단 민사소송까지 이어져 통장 전액 압류당하고 파산함.  자영업자들 피눈물 흘리게 만들며 악질 협박하다가 제대로 임자 만나 인생 망한 역대급 사이다 참교육 사건임.

Iran says the war has no military solution as talks with Washington stall; its oil minister resigns  Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi told foreign ambassadors in Tehran on Sunday: “There is no military solution, nor any solution based on new sanctions.” He said only “negotiations based on justice and fairness” could end the conflict. “If our enemies again choose the path of military confrontation, our response will be stronger than before,” he said, according to AFP. The AP quoted him saying that “if they seek diplomatic avenues, we remain ready to reach a fair and honorable solution through diplomacy to end this war.” Parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf said the US had recently sent proposals through a mediator but gave no details. He said Iran’s seven conditions for fully reopening the Strait of Hormuz still stand. Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi said Tehran is examining US views on its proposal. Foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei said the latest US counterproposal was “in line with their previous proposals concerning nuclear issues.”  Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad resigned, and President Masoud Pezeshkian accepted the resignation. Hamid Bovard, chief executive of the National Iranian Oil Company, was named acting oil minister. The AP said the reason was not immediately clear and noted that Iran’s oil exports are under pressure from tighter US sanctions and a naval blockade. AFP said the resignation came as queues at Iranian petrol stations grow.  On Sunday, the UK Maritime Trade Operations centre (UKMTO) said a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz reported being hit by an unknown projectile that damaged its engine room. The crew was reported safe, and the agency did not say when the incident happened. The AP said the US Navy-overseen Joint Maritime Information Center reported that three tankers were struck while transiting the strait on Saturday. Separately, a tanker reported explosions about 60 nautical miles south of Mokha, near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait off Yemen. Iran’s demands include a ceasefire across the Middle East, the unfreezing of its assets, the lifting of oil sanctions and an end to the US naval blockade. Trump rejected that proposal. AFP said the US has not struck Iran since 1 September but has been building up its forces in the region. US pulls all its bombers out of Britain’s RAF Fairford after a suspected terror plot  The United States has withdrawn all of its bombers from RAF Fairford in Gloucestershire and sent them back to their home stations, a US department official confirmed on Sunday, the BBC reported. The AP, citing a Pentagon official who spoke on condition of anonymity, said observers saw a number of B-1 bombers fly out of the base on Sunday. The Military Air Tracking Alliance has seen dozens of B-52 and B-1 bombers operating from Fairford since the opening days of the Iran war. Washington gave no reason. The BBC said Whitehall sources did not dispute that the move was a response to the incident at the base. It was told the decision was military rather than political, taken at an operational level. The UK Ministry of Defence has not commented.  On 27 September, police were alerted to three “suspicious vehicles” near the base. Five UK nationals from London, aged 23 to 25, were arrested on suspicion of explosives offences and later of preparing a terrorist act. All five were released on bail. A sixth man, a 25-year-old UK-Iranian national, was arrested in London on Thursday and was also released on bail, police confirmed on Saturday. Prime Minister Andy Burnham said there were “strong indications” Iran had played a part. Tehran strongly denies involvement. In July, Iran said “any base used for aggression against Iranian territory constitutes a legitimate target.”  US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the incident “clearly involve[d] the hands of a foreign actor.” Trump said he was “surprised” the five men had been released on bail. The AP said Trump is weighing options for the war on Iran, including new strikes. “It’ll either be the easy way, or the hard way,” he said on Saturday. A US official said on Thursday that the USS Theodore Roosevelt aircraft carrier and the USS Malkin Island amphibious readiness group are heading for the Middle East. That could put three carriers in the region as early as the end of October. A government doesn’t need to explicitly order police to be violent to influence how aggressively they enforce its agenda.  In Victoria, the Police Minister can issue written directions about policing policy and priorities under section 10 of the Victoria Police Act. There are limits protecting operational independence, but that doesn’t mean police operate in a vacuum, disconnected from government.  Governments shape the laws, funding and policy priorities.  Their public messaging also signals what enforcement approach they support & this is where it counts for Victoria and COVID and the police response. Dan was on TV every single day talking about people who weren't doing "what they were told", and using specific language about how those people would be dealt with.  That can influence organisational culture and whether restraint or a harder approach feels politically rewarded.  During COVID, Andrews repeatedly condemned protesters. In September 2020, he called protesting “selfish”, “stupid” and “dangerous”, warning that participants would be dealt with and fined. He also defended police following the filmed incident involving a woman being dragged from her car. Those statements publicly reinforced a hard enforcement approach.  That is what I mean by a political “green light”: leadership creating and reinforcing the climate in which enforcement occurs. It is an argument about political responsibility, rather than proof of a specific instruction to use unlawful force.  Individual officers and police commanders remain responsible for their actions. But operational independence should not become a shield allowing the government to avoid scrutiny of the policies, rhetoric and political backing it supplied.

🇷🇺 The Russia plague story is serious, but the internet may be getting way ahead of the evidence.  Robert Malone has looked closely at reports of a possible pneumonic plague incident near Irkutsk. And his first conclusion is important:  “Calling it an outbreak at this point is a little premature.”  According to the information Malone reviewed, a laboratory worker in her twenties appears to have been accidentally infected while working with Yersinia pestis, the bacterium that causes plague.  She later died after several days in medical care, potentially exposing others. Malone says roughly 200 hospital workers have reportedly been quarantined.  That sounds terrifying.  But he thinks the evidence currently points much more strongly toward a laboratory accident than a biological weapons event. There are still things he wants explained.  Was the researcher vaccinated? Why did someone known to work with plague not receive appropriate antibiotics sooner? And most importantly, what does sequencing show about the strain?  “The honest truth is, no, we don't” know whether it was natural or engineered, Malone says.  He says the U.S. State Department is seeking more information from Russia and has not yet received a response.  But Malone also sees something reassuring.  So far, he says Russia appears to be doing what should happen after a suspected exposure: contact tracing, quarantine and containment. He sees no evidence yet of coordinated suppression or disinformation that would make him substantially more suspicious.  Plague is also treatable with antibiotics and considerably harder to transmit than the word itself tends to suggest.  So Malone’s message is basically the opposite of the internet’s instinct whenever Russia, laboratory and plague appear in the same sentence:  Watch it carefully.  But don’t manufacture the apocalypse before the evidence arrives.  “The biggest thing you have to fear is fear itself at this moment. It's not pneumonic plague.”  @RWMaloneMD

NEAR Intents suffered a roughly $3.8 million exploit after a bug in the interaction between its Omni deposit-and-withdrawal infrastructure and the NEAR Intents smart contract. Services and deposits or withdrawals on several networks were paused. The vulnerability was patched, and the funds were reportedly returned one day later.  My read: rapid recovery is a useful incident-response result, not proof that cross-chain intent systems are safe.  The project’s preliminary report put the loss at about $3.8 million and said affected funds would be reimbursed in full. NEAR’s official notice said operations could resume within about an hour, while deposits and withdrawals on 11 networks would remain unavailable for roughly 12 more hours.  Users and the platform benefited from the recovery. But users still paid the cost of an outage, while the team had to rely on emergency intervention, investigation and a compensation promise. The attacker’s identity and the exact return mechanism remain less transparent than the recovery headline.  Intent-based cross-chain trading hides routing complexity from users. That is convenient, but it concentrates trust in the solver, deposit logic, withdrawal logic and monitoring layer behind the interface. A bug at that boundary can affect several chains at once.  The $3.8 million figure is preliminary, and the return was reported by NEAR’s leadership. An independent technical post-mortem and proof of lasting remediation still matter.  My conclusion: recovery is not security. Cross-chain convenience creates a larger promise—and a larger place to fail.

When a crow finds another crow lying lifeless, it often does not just fly away. It calls out. Other crows gather. They become alert. They watch the area carefully. Scientists have studied this behavior, sometimes called a “crow funeral,” and what they’ve found is striking. The crows do not appear to gather out of sentimentality in the human sense. They gather to learn. They look for danger. They try to understand what happened. And if they identify a threat, they remember it. Crows are highly intelligent. They can recognize faces, remember risks, and warn others. So when they gather around a fallen crow, they may be doing something deeply adaptive: turning loss into awareness, and awareness into protection. There is something important in that. Many humans are taught to look away from what is painful. To avoid it. To numb themselves. But crows do something else. They pay attention. They investigate. They learn together. That is a form of intelligence. Not just mental intelligence, but social intelligence. The kind that understands survival is not only about individual strength, but about shared awareness. About noticing danger. About communicating it. About helping the group become wiser because one life was lost. Maybe that is part of what emotional intelligence really is too. Not collapsing in the face of pain. Not ignoring it. But staying present enough to learn from it, and caring enough to make that knowledge useful to others. A fallen crow does not go unnoticed. The others gather. They pay attention. And they carry the lesson forward.

Fighting in the Taiz–Lahj sector killed more than 70 fighters in a single day by local accounts. - The strategic prize is the Bab al-Mandeb corridor. Houthi seizure of Mokha and adjacent coastal positions last month collapsed government lines and placed an Iranian-aligned force astride a chokepoint already strained by disruptions at Hormuz. Reversing that gain is the coalition’s first operational requirement. - Government claims of 257 precision strikes and at least 700 Houthi dead on 3 October are unverified. The coalition separately reported 97 targeting operations against Houthi reinforcements on the Tor al-Baha and Taiz axes. The Houthis claim Saudi and coalition aircraft conducted roughly 50 to 100 strikes in a 12-to-24-hour window and answered with ballistic missiles and drones against Aramco sites near Riyadh and at Khurais. Saudi authorities have not confirmed damage. - More than 200 U.S. intelligence and military analysts are inside Saudi command centers helping develop and select targets for Yemeni partners. U.S. tankers are refueling Saudi aircraft on defensive patrols. No U.S. strike package or ground element is committed to the offensive.  SITUATION ON THE GROUND  The 2022 truce is dead. Relative quiet ended after the wider regional war opened in February. From July the Houthis resumed missile and drone attacks on Saudi shipping and energy sites, declared pressure on Red Sea routes used for Saudi exports, and then drove south along the coast. Government-aligned units abandoned Mokha and much of the defensive belt running from southern Hodeidah through western Taiz toward Bab al-Mandeb. Perim and the Hanish islands area also shifted in the fighting. The result is the largest Houthi land gain in years and a direct threat to the sea lane that connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden.  Taiz is now the immediate crisis. Houthi units have closed the last reliable road to Aden, halted traffic, and surrounded the city from the south and west. Government and local forces, many of them Islah-linked, are still resisting on the ridges, but the supply position is deteriorating. Aden remains the seat of the recognized government and the logistics base for any counterstroke. Loss of the Taiz corridor would split government-held territory and expose the southern approaches.  Coalition fires have intensified in parallel. Strikes have hit Houthi movement corridors, reinforcement routes, and reported positions in Sanaa, Saada, and the southwest. Houthi media describe repeated attacks on the capital and claim the Aramco strikes as retaliation. Neither side’s casualty figures can be confirmed. What is clear is that both are now treating the front as active war rather than a managed stalemate.  FORCES AND COMMAND  Houthi strengths are terrain, cohesion, and strike reach. A decade of war has produced experienced infantry, extensive mountain and tunnel defenses in the northern highlands, and a mature inventory of ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and one-way attack drones, much of it enabled by Iran. They have already demonstrated the ability to hit Saudi energy infrastructure and to threaten shipping. Their weakness is exposure once they leave fortified ground and attempt to hold a long coastal strip under sustained air attack.  Government weaknesses are structural. The Presidential Leadership Council is an eight-man body sitting over tribal levies, Islah formations, southern units, and other factions that share little beyond opposition to the Houthis. Command is divided, logistics are uneven, and several of these forces collapsed or withdrew during the coastal offensive. Saudi Arabia supplies the money, the air force, and much of the operational direction. Without continuous coalition air cover, Yemeni ground units have not shown they can hold recently lost terrain, let alone retake Sanaa or the northern heartland.  The campaign plan, as described by regional and Western officials before the announcement, pairs Saudi-led aerial combat with Yemeni ground maneuver. Tens of thousands of government-aligned fighters are assessed to be available. That number does not equal combat power. Unity of effort remains the unresolved problem.  STRATEGIC STAKES  Bab al-Mandeb is the hinge. Traffic through the strait feeds the Red Sea and the Suez route. With Hormuz already constrained, a second chokepoint under Houthi influence raises insurance costs, slows energy flows, and gives Tehran an indirect lever on Saudi export options. The coalition’s stated aim is not a local ceasefire. Al-Alimi’s language and the Saudi pledge both point to restoration of state control and destruction of Houthi military capacity.  Iran’s interest is the opposite. An active Yemen front consumes Saudi attention, threatens Gulf energy sites, and adds pressure on Red Sea shipping at low direct cost to Tehran. Houthi rhetoric continues to frame government forces as Saudi mercenaries and the fight as liberation. Neither side is signaling a near-term pause.  HUMANITARIAN AND REAR-AREA EFFECTS  Fighting since early August has killed more than 800 people by World Health Organization figures and displaced more than 150,000 in the current phase. Roughly five million Yemenis were already internally displaced. Nearly half the population remains acutely food insecure. Encirclement of Taiz and renewed urban fighting will accelerate civilian displacement and restrict aid access along the Aden road. Coalition strikes in populated northern areas and Houthi missile attacks on Saudi facilities both carry escalation risk beyond the front line.  IMPLICATIONS  Energy markets and shipping face immediate pressure if the coastal fight continues and Houthi strike tempo against Saudi infrastructure rises. A successful coalition push that restores control of Mokha and the strait approaches would reduce that pressure. Failure would leave an Iranian-aligned force entrenched on the Red Sea.  Saudi Arabia has reserved the right to answer attacks on its territory. Further confirmed damage to Aramco sites would raise the probability of deeper Saudi strikes and a longer air campaign. The recognized government cannot sustain the offensive alone.  U.S. equities are freedom of navigation through Bab al-Mandeb, the security of a principal Gulf partner, and avoidance of an open-ended combat commitment. Present support stays inside Saudi Arabia and below the threshold of direct strikes. Any expansion would require decisions on rules of engagement, force protection, and the risk of Iranian or Houthi retaliation against U.S. assets. Houthi missile and drone range already covers targets relevant to that calculation.  OUTLOOK  The next phase will be decided around Taiz and on the coastal plain. Relieving the Aden road and pushing Houthi units off the approaches to Bab al-Mandeb are the near-term military tasks. Houthi defensive terrain, government command friction, and the absence of a unified Yemeni ground force make a rapid nationwide reconquest unlikely. Saudi air endurance will set the tempo. Absent a freeze negotiated through existing channels, expect continued cross-border strikes, high civilian displacement, and elevated risk to Red Sea traffic through the remainder of 2026.  #Yemen #Houthis #SaudiArabia #BabAlMandeb #RedSea #Aden #Taiz #MiddleEast #NationalSecurity #IranWar‌

PENTAGON CONFIRMS: ALL U.S. B-1 BOMBERS HAVE BEEN PULLED OUT OF RAF FAIRFORD  The Pentagon has now confirmed that every American bomber deployed to RAF Fairford has been returned to its home base in the United States following new intelligence surrounding the suspected terrorist plot against the base.  A Pentagon spokesperson said operational security prevented the U.S. from confirming the movements in real time, but acknowledged Sunday that all U.S. bombers deployed to Fairford had now redeployed to the United States.  According to the NYT, the withdrawal happened at an unusually rapid pace after American commanders received fresh intelligence that dramatically increased the perceived urgency of the threat.  At least 10 B-1 bombers departed Fairford on Sunday, including aircraft that had arrived in Britain less than a week earlier as part of a normal rotation.  The evacuation was reportedly so urgent that some bombers and their crews began departing for the United States while tanker aircraft assigned to support their flights were still being prepared.  U.S. officials said the new intelligence was connected to the same threat warnings that emerged after the suspected plot against RAF Fairford, but that the specificity and urgency of the intelligence increased sharply within the previous 24 hours.  British authorities have been investigating whether individuals involved in the Fairford incident were acting on behalf of a foreign state. An Iranian-linked motive has been considered a leading possibility by investigators, while Iran has denied involvement.  The threat assessment reportedly also includes concern that future attacks could involve drones.  This is what makes the development so striking: Rapidly evacuating an entire deployed bomber force from a major NATO ally because of a security threat is extraordinarily unusual — especially when the base is hundreds of miles from any active battlefield.  RAF Fairford has played an important role in U.S. operations connected to Iran, and Tehran’s Revolutionary Guards previously warned that bases used for American attacks against Iran could be considered legitimate targets.  Whatever intelligence reached U.S. commanders this weekend, they clearly considered it serious enough not to leave the B-1 fleet at Fairford.
